title: 宠物用品新赛道初探
titleEn: Pet Supplies Business: New Track Exploration

intro.background: 教玩具到宠物用品是天然延伸——木材工艺、安全标准、非标定制能力都能复用。温尚已有宠物饲养笼和游乐设备专利。宠物赛道核心：宠物家具（猫爬架、狗屋）、宠物游乐、人宠共用空间。认证：ASTM F963（美标玩具）、EN71也适用。
intro.desc: 了解宠物用品赛道的英语表达。
tasks: 理解宠物赛道和教玩具的关联

oneLiner.en: The shift from kindergarten to pets is not a new start — it is applying woodworking, safety and customization to furry friends.
oneLiner.cn: 从幼儿园到宠物不是新开始——而是把木工、安全和定制能力用在毛孩子身上。

vocab.ex: Cat trees are made from solid wood.

vocab.ipa: /ˈeɪ eɪ tiː em ef ˈnaɪnti sɪks θriː/
vocab.ex: Pet toys should meet ASTM F963.
All materials are pet-friendly and non-toxic.
vocab.exCn: 所有材料宠物友好无毒。

mistakes.right: We are extending our woodworking expertise to pet furniture — cat trees, dog houses and pet playgrounds.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说做幼儿园。要讲能力延伸。

basic.en: Cat trees are our new product.
We use sisal for scratching posts.

advanced.en: Leveraging our solid wood manufacturing and safety expertise, we have expanded into pet furniture — including cat trees, dog houses and indoor pet playgrounds, all non-toxic and ASTM-compliant.
advanced.cn: 利用我们实木制造和安全经验，我们拓展到宠物家具——猫爬架、狗屋、室内宠物游乐，全部无毒符合ASTM。

advanced.en: Our pet furniture line uses FSC-certified rubberwood, non-toxic finishes, and durable sisal scratching posts — designed with both pet safety and owner aesthetics in mind.
advanced.cn: 我们的宠物家具用FSC认证橡胶木、无毒涂装、耐用剑麻抓柱——兼顾宠物安全和主人审美。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: I see you make kindergarten furniture. Do you do pet products?
lines.cn: 我看你们做幼儿园家具。你们做宠物产品吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Yes, we recently launched a pet furniture line. We make cat trees, dog houses and indoor pet playgrounds using the same solid wood and safety standards.
lines.cn: 是的，我们最近推出宠物家具线。用同样的实木和安全标准做猫爬架、狗屋、室内宠物游乐。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Interesting. What materials do you use?
lines.cn: 有意思。你们用什么材料？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: FSC-certified rubberwood, non-toxic finishes, and durable sisal for scratching posts. All pet-friendly and safe.
lines.cn: FSC认证橡胶木、无毒涂装、耐用剑麻抓柱。全部宠物友好安全。

fillBlank.q: Cat ____ are made from solid wood.

scenario.q: A client asks if you make pet products. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: Yes, we recently launched a pet furniture line. We make cat trees, dog houses and indoor pet playgrounds using the same FSC-certified solid wood and non-toxic finishes as our kindergarten furniture. All products are ASTM-compliant and pet-friendly. We can send our pet catalog if you are interested.
scenario.cn: 是的，我们最近推出宠物家具线。用和幼儿园家具同样的FSC认证实木和无毒涂装做猫爬架、狗屋、室内宠物游乐。全部符合ASTM、宠物友好。有兴趣可以发宠物目录。

culture.title: 宠物赛道的机会
culture.content: 宠物经济全球增长快，尤其欧美。教玩具厂转宠物有天然优势：木工工艺、安全标准、非标定制都能复用。关键是审美——宠物产品不只是功能，还要像家居装饰品。

rounds.hint: 是的，猫爬架狗屋宠物游乐。
可以，同幼儿园定制能力。
